requirements.name: node
requirements.install: Install Node.js 22 or newer from https://nodejs.org

fields.label: Request type
fields.description: Which request type is this: plan-and-implement, plan-only or review-and-integrate?

fields.label: Objective
fields.description: What outcome should this change achieve?

fields.label: Expected behavior
fields.description: How should the product behave once this is done?
fields.sample: The invoice list offers a CSV download for the displayed invoices.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.description: Which observable acceptance criteria decide that it is done?
fields.sample:
1. The download contains one row per displayed invoice.
2. Each row includes the invoice number and total.

fields.label: Exclusions
fields.description: What is explicitly out of scope?
fields.sample: Changing invoice totals or adding another export format is out of scope.

fields.label: Relevant context
fields.description: Which existing behavior, issue or contract is relevant?
fields.sample: The product already displays an invoice list.

fields.label: Risk
fields.description: Is the risk low, medium or high?

fields.label: Existing task
fields.description: Which approved task does this refer to?

fields.label: Pull request
fields.description: Which pull request in this repository should be reviewed? Give its number, for example #12.

fields.label: Task or brief
fields.description: Which task or brief, and which version, does the pull request implement?
